'''Red Bush Grove''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] village several days' travel south of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].

==History==
All of its denizens, minus [[Leektar/Legends|Leektar]] and [[Keoulkeech]], were killed in a devastating fire that was the result of a lightning storm. The fire occurred some time before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], and destroyed the entire village.

==Behind the scenes==
Red Bush Grove was first mentioned in the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for Leektar published on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="LeektarDB" /> on [[November 18]], [[2005]].<ref name="PublishDate">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20051118.html|text=What's the Story, Round 3}}</ref> The entry was written by [[Arthur Papadam]] and [[Andrew Gilbertson]] under their respective aliases "Arf Maul" and "Hecko Tenton"<ref name="LeektarDB" /> through the "[[What's The Story?]]" feature available for users of [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club]].<ref name="PublishDate" /> 

The village was created and named by Papadam using the naming convention of Bright Tree Village. The village was initially conceived as "Red Bush Village," as he was unaware of the previous Endor villages established in other material. He also envisioned the village's destruction, caused via natural disaster, as a tribute to the people affected by [[Wikipedia:Saffir-Simpson scale|Category 5]] hurricanes occurring around the time. Papadam's entry started with the destruction of the village from a horrible storm that flattens out the tree dwellings and kills it's inhabitants. Leektar, shaman of the Kewena tribe occupying the village, survives by being absent from the destruction. In the editing process, the village's name and it's end&mdash;now a lighting-sparked fire&mdash;were changed.<ref name="ArfMaul">{{Blog|arfmaul|6|Leektar's Story: Everything you didn't need to know!}}</ref>
